description.value: This BC Liquor Store (store #204) is a provincial government-operated retail outlet in Ganges, the main commercial hub of Salt Spring Island. It stocks wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders, making it a practical stop for cycle tourists looking to pick up local BC craft beer or island-area wines. The store also accepts empty container returns for recycling.
